note: Reference verdicts of the exact forms on every profile, 2026-10-30. Negative ExciteV delays are reference errors on CR6 (Program too big for task memory with U1; Vx1 is not a CR6 channel) and CR1000X, so OCB003's ExciteV rows exist for CR300/CR350 only. Fractional negative delays above one microsecond below zero (ExciteV(U1,0,-0.9) on CR6, Delay(1,-0.9,uSec)) compile and are not reported.
